data.title: Senior care from a family who got into this for the right reasons
data.subtitle: Driftless Care Companions started when our founder couldn't find someone to care for her own mother. Eleven years later, we still hire and train every caregiver personally.

data.title: Every caregiver is trained by someone whose name is on the agency
data.subtitle: We don't subcontract. We don't use agencies-of-agencies. The caregivers who walk through your loved one's door went through training led by the same family who'd send their own parents to the same care.

data.heading: What we cover
data.intro: Four service tracks. Most clients use two or three over time as needs change. The same caregiver carries the relationship through.

items.title: Companion care
items.description: Conversation, meals, light housekeeping, errands. The hours when family can't be there.

items.title: Personal care
items.description: Bathing, dressing, grooming, mobility, medication reminders. CBRF-certified, dignity-first.

items.title: Dementia specialty
items.description: Teepa Snow Positive Approach trained. Continuity of caregiver to reduce confusion.

items.title: Hospice support
items.description: Continuous bedside presence. Coordinates with your hospice nurse + chaplain.

data.heading: Talk to someone today
data.subtitle: Free, confidential consultation. We'll listen first and tell you straight whether we're the right fit.
